style: Handheld documentary realism, like a low-budget Hong Kong indie drama shot at night with one small cinema camera. 35mm-equivalent lens for mediums, 50mm for close shots, shallow but not creamy depth of field. Mixed practical light: green-white fluorescent tubes overhead, warm spill from the kitchen. Slight sensor grain, natural contrast, no teal-and-orange grade.

characters.name: 阿欣
characters.look: Hong Kong Chinese woman, 28. Oval face, tired eyes with faint dark circles, straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind one ear, thin build, no visible make-up beyond smudged eyeliner.
characters.wardrobe: Pale blue long-sleeved office blouse with the top button open and sleeves pushed to the elbow, charcoal knee-length skirt, staff lanyard with a blank white card, small black shoulder bag on the seat beside her.
characters.voice: Woman in her late twenties, mid-low pitch, quiet and flat from tiredness, clean Hong Kong Cantonese, slightly drawn-out sentence endings.
characters.zh: 28 歲 OL，黑色及膊直髮，一邊撥去耳後，眼有少少黑眼圈。淺藍色長袖恤衫，袖捲到手踭，深灰及膝裙，掛住白色員工證。把聲偏低、冇力、尾音拖少少。

characters.name: 強哥
characters.look: Hong Kong Chinese man, 55. Square face, deep nasolabial lines, short grey-flecked crew cut, thick eyebrows, weathered tanned skin, stocky with a slight belly.
characters.wardrobe: White short-sleeved cotton waiter shirt, slightly yellowed at the collar, a pen clipped in the chest pocket, black trousers, a white tea towel over the left shoulder.
characters.voice: Man in his mid fifties, rough mid pitch, fast and loud, old-school Hong Kong Cantonese with clipped endings, never hesitant.
characters.zh: 55 歲茶餐廳伙記，國字面，平頭有白髮，皮膚黑實，有少少肚腩。白色短袖伙記恤衫，領口有啲黃，袋口插住支筆，黑色西褲，左膊搭住條白毛巾。把聲粗、講嘢快同大聲。

locations.name: 茶餐廳卡位
locations.look: A four-seat booth in an old Hong Kong cha chaan teng: dark green vinyl bench seats with a cracked corner, a worn laminate table with a glass top over paper menus, pale green wall tiles to shoulder height, cream paint above stained by years of steam, a wall fan, a plastic menu holder, a napkin dispenser and a bottle of soy sauce on the table.
locations.light: Cold fluorescent tubes on the ceiling, a warmer glow from the kitchen at the far end, a little neon colour from the street through the front glass.
locations.zh: 舊式茶餐廳四人卡位：墨綠色膠梳化有一角爆咗，玻璃枱面壓住餐牌，淺綠色牆磚去到膊頭高，上面米色牆身俾蒸氣燻到黃。凌晨一點，天花光管白光，遠處廚房有暖光。

locations.name: 茶餐廳水吧
locations.look: The drinks station of the same cha chaan teng: a stainless-steel counter crowded with a tea urn, tins of evaporated milk, a tub of cut lemons, a metal sugar tin with a long spoon, stacked glasses, a hand-written order spike. Scuffed white wall tiles behind, a small extractor fan.
locations.light: One bare fluorescent tube directly above the counter, steam catching the light.
locations.zh: 同一間茶餐廳嘅水吧：不銹鋼枱面擺滿茶桶、花奶罐、檸檬片、鐵糖罐同長羹、疊起嘅玻璃杯。後面白色牆磚。頭頂一支光管，有蒸氣。

props.name: 凍檸茶
props.look: A tall clear ribbed glass tumbler, three lemon slices pressed against the inside, dark amber tea, large ice cubes, a white straw, condensation on the outside. About the height of a hand.
props.zh: 高身坑紋玻璃杯，三片檸檬貼住杯邊，深啡色茶，大粒冰，白色飲管，杯外有水珠。大約一隻手掌高。
